result.summary: A screenshot of the Zephyr code editor application. The left side shows a file explorer with many markdown and log files, the center shows a welcome screen with an open file button and a terminal panel below, and the right side shows an AI agent chat panel. The main focus requested is the right-hand AI panel, which has several distinct bands including a tab header, a chat log with a tool-use block, and an input box at the bottom.
